specBase: PROPOSALS/U4a-proposal.md Revision 2, sections 8 and 9 M5 (pre-registered at 5d83779)

ladder._reason: Section 8.5 requires one audible passage but names none. E9 secondary passage: single speaker, full word recovery at every position (20/20/18).

alignment._reason: Section 8.5 predicts a shift of the voiced region but does not define its measurement. B-to-B lag over the full range avoids all three banned sources (word timestamps, callback arrival, A/B-agreement-maximizing offset).

requestLifecycle._reason: Section 8.3's last-final-wins and superseded-final counting require listening past the first final; 55 s chunking matches E3 and production rollover.

frameMatching._reason: Section 8.6 requires fitting only independently aligned voiced frames; the boundary guard removes pairings that alignment uncertainty makes ambiguous.

fit._reason: Section 8.6 names a fit with a held-out split but no model; running all three leave-one-out rotations is a documented superset of fit-on-two-test-on-third.

coverage._note: Section 8.7 restated as data, not an amendment.
